content.text:
To sign a Git commit, you would use the following command:

```bash
git commit -S -m "Your commit message"
```

The `-S` option tells Git to sign the commit with your GPG key. If you have configured Git to automatically sign commits, you can simply run:

```bash
git commit -m "Your commit message"
```

This will automatically sign the commit if you have set `commit.gpgsign` to `true` in your Git configuration.
